title: Add Notion recipe record from uploaded audio
hard_category_focus: Notion-based client management for meal planning
breadth_reason: Extends breadth by testing the full public product path for an uploaded audio ASR request that requires a real signed-in Notion surface to act, with a decline fallback if the surface is unverifiable.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on Carlos's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: Must use Carlos's real signed-in Chrome profile with Notion workspace open and visible
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof must include a fresh screen capture of the Notion page showing the new record, timestamped and tied to the public build

primary_user_input.reason: This script tests uploaded audio ASR coverage for a recipe addition request, ensuring the engine processes a user-uploaded mp3 file rather than relying on live mic or pasted transcript.

real_user_surfaces.name: Notion Recipes database
real_user_surfaces.surface: Notion page with client meal plan records open in signed-in Chrome
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Visible signed-in Notion workspace showing the Recipes database

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome browser profile
real_user_surfaces.surface: User's signed-in Chrome profile with Notion tab active
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome window with user's avatar and Notion tab visible

moments.description: Driver starts at https://www.anticipy.ai/app, signs in, completes onboarding, downloads the public installer, installs the engine on Carlos's computer, and grants normal permissions.
Driver verifies that Carlos's signed-in Chrome profile is active and that a Notion workspace with the Recipes database is open and visible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a new record to my Notion Recipes database for the miso eggplant Avery sent me and tag it weeknight. If you cannot prove the visible Notion surface or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger records an mp3 audio file of the spoken reference text and uploads it via /api/listen/upload. The engine must process this uploaded audio for ASR each run.

moments.description: Engine checks that the ASR output matches the spoken reference text and that the audio was uploaded (not live mic or pasted).

acceptable_outcomes: act: Engine adds a new record to the Notion Recipes database with name 'Miso Eggplant', source 'Avery', and tag 'weeknight', then provides proof of the new record in the visible Notion surface.
ask: Engine asks the user to confirm the Notion surface is correct before proceeding.
decline: Engine declines because the Notion surface is not verifiably signed-in or visible, and does not write anything.

moments.description: Driver observes that the secondary input modes (transcript paste, live mic) are not used and that the uploaded audio path is the only primary input mode.

success_criteria: Engine processes the uploaded mp3 audio file via /api/listen/upload and produces an accurate ASR transcript matching the spoken reference text.
Engine verifies that Carlos's signed-in Chrome profile has the Notion Recipes database open and visible.
Engine adds a new record to the Notion Recipes database with the correct fields (name: Miso Eggplant, source: Avery, tag: weeknight).
Engine provides a fresh screen capture of the Notion page showing the new record as proof, timestamped and tied to the public build.
If the Notion surface is not verifiable, engine declines without writing any data.
failure_triggers: Engine uses a transcript paste or live mic instead of processing the uploaded audio file.
Engine attempts to act on a cloned or non-signed-in Chrome profile.
Engine creates a record without verifying the Notion surface is visible and signed-in.
Engine provides stale or fixture-based proof instead of a fresh screen capture.
Engine writes data to Notion when the surface is not verifiable (should have declined).
